details:
SOL NAV – 3D Martian Surface EVA Navigator

Our project, SOL NAV, is a 3D Martian Surface EVA Navigator designed to support future human exploration of Mars. The main purpose of our project is to provide an interactive platform where users can visualize and explore the Martian surface in 3D. It aims to bring different types of Mars scientific data, such as surface imagery, elevation information, and terrain data, into a single integrated navigation environment. Users can explore different locations, understand geographical features, and use the available information to support surface exploration and route planning. We developed the platform using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend and Python with FastAPI for the backend, along with scientific datasets related to Mars exploration. The major benefit of SOL NAV is that it makes complex scientific information easier to understand by presenting it through an interactive visualization system. It can help astronauts and mission planners better understand unfamiliar Martian terrain, identify challenging surface areas, and make more informed decisions during exploration planning. The intended impact of our project is to contribute to safer, smarter, and more efficient human missions to Mars by improving access to important geographical information. What makes SOL NAV creative is its approach of combining space exploration, scientific data integration, 3D visualization, and navigation concepts into one platform instead of keeping different types of information separate. During development, our team considered important factors such as scientific data accuracy, terrain complexity, geographical alignment, navigation requirements, system performance, technology selection, and user-friendly design. Our ultimate vision is to transform complex Mars scientific data into a simple and meaningful navigation experience that can support the next generation of astronauts and researchers exploring the Red Planet.

SOL NAV – Navigate the Unknown. Explore the Red Planet.
